body.title: Ship and smoke on this repository
body.summary: Update the installed daemon and restart it from ~/.insrc/daemon; the migration runs and every repository reads 'a reindex is needed'; let this repository's queued full index end; record in S001/smoke.md: before and after counts of pending rows (by kind before, by class and reason after), unwritable 0, findCallers(runGrepSearch) = 4 outside test files, findCallers(stripReviewSection) = 4, the doc summaries regenerated, completeness shown by repo.stats, the CLI, JetBrains and the VS Code Daemon tab. Depends on every earlier task through t11 (the reindex) and t12-t16 (the surfaces it checks). Test-file callers of runGrepSearch are in src/daemon/tools/builtins/search/__tests__/grep-core.test.ts and grep-omitted.test.ts.
acceptanceChecks: smoke.md records runGrepSearch 4 and stripReviewSection 4 stored callers, unwritable 0, and the class counts
The four status surfaces show the repository's completeness
The doc-summarise-repo job for this repository completes and its summary count after the reindex equals the count before (or the difference is explained in smoke.md)

tests.name: S001/smoke.md on this repository: before/after counts, runGrepSearch 4 and stripReviewSection 4 outside test files, unwritable 0, doc summaries regenerated, completeness on all four surfaces
